persons.name: Viṣṇusiṃha
persons.evidence: viṣṇusiṃha, tat putre lakṣmi(!)sundaradaivajña, dvayo(!) ... liṣitaṃ

date.as_written: śaśiṛtugajapṛthvīvarṣasaṃvatsaraṃ ca madhukalitithigaurī somavāreṇa ... samvat 1861 nepālasamvat 925 caitravadi 3 svātinakṣatre, vyāghātayoge jathā(!)karṇamuhurtte, somavāra(!)sare

notes: Both VS 1861 (also given in chronogram: śaśi-ṛtu-gaja-pṛthvī = 1861) and NS 925 are recorded. The manuscript was copied jointly by Viṣṇusiṃha and his son Lakṣmīsundara Daivajña (dvayoḥ ... likhitam) at Cayanpura village near the Karvuddā river; they appear to be originally of Bhaktapatananagara (Bhaktapur).
